description: Engine setup of map3_s05 (Hospital Otherworld - basement), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type HU, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Creeper, PuppetNurse, DummyNurse, PuppetDoctor and DummyDoctor). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: particle_emitter (the fire/smoke particle emitter whose parameters come from the overlay header). A mod changes it with its own maps/map3_s05/overlay.json.
